patthana16.85:1.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naanidassanaappaṭigho napītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho napītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…pe… anidassanaappaṭighaṃ pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho napītisahagato ca naanidassanasappaṭigho napītisahagato ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
patthana16.85:2.1: Anidassanaappaṭighaṃ napītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nasanidassanasappaṭigho nanapītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
